THE WHOLE THING IN ONE SENTENCE: an owner-member signs in and answers three questions without asking anyone — what came in, what it cost me, what I get back — and their bookkeeper closes a period from the export.

STRIPE IN: mirrored READ-ONLY against the member's company row. DO NOT POKE CONNECT — no test charges, sessions, customers or retry loops, ever; it was blocked once and spamming it takes the money path down. Connect state on the company row as a NAMED state so "payouts not connected" is visible rather than a member who silently never gets paid.

E-BOEKHOUDEN OUT: the EXPORT is the deliverable, we build no bookkeeping. Alex picked it for the accountant, not the API — a Dutch boekhouder is used to being handed access, so a co-owner accountant walks in without a migration. Entries per period per member, double-entry, COST AND MARKUP AS SEPARATE LINES because the markup line is exactly what patronage refunds; blended, it cannot be computed. THE TEST: if a bookkeeper cannot close a period from it, the feature failed.

THREE REPORTS, as a FILTER ON THE ONE WATERFALL, not a BI tool: what came in · what it cost, with our markup shown separately · what I get back, the patronage position, LABELLED PROVISIONAL until the statuten/notary gate lands and never presented as a promise.

1. SELF-BILLING, not payrolling. Members are co-owners, not employees; no employer relationship to insure against. Caveat stands: co-ownership strengthens the case, practice is still judged, the accountant confirms.
2. SELLER OF RECORD IS US. Standard for marketplaces and the only version where the accounting survives 20k authors — we owe VAT, author earnings are a cost line, we self-bill rather than receive 20k

== CORRECTION: THE MEMBER CONNECTS THEIR OWN STRIPE ==
I wrote 5937 as mirroring OUR platform Connect state. Wrong. The MEMBER connects THEIR OWN Stripe and we read THEIRS — Connect OAuth, READ-ONLY scope, one token per company row, revocable by them at any time. Same shape as the books connector: they bring their own account, they keep it, we read.
OUR platform Connect account is a separate thing and the DO-NOT-POKE rule still governs it absolutely.

== VAT: SIMPLER THAN I MADE IT, PER ALEX ==
"Users have to enter a VAT number, it gets checked, that's it."
VAT number entered at signup → validated against VIES (EU's free lookup, no key) → stored on the company row. That is the whole mechanism.
The rule falls straight out of it for digital services: valid number + different member state = B2B reverse charge. No number = B2C at the buyer's rate.

THREE THINGS TO GET RIGHT, all small:
1. STORE THE VALIDATION RESULT AND ITS TIMESTAMP, not just the number. VIES returns a consultation reference — that is the proof we checked. Numbers get deregistered, so recheck periodically.
2. STAMP THE TREATMENT ON THE TRANSACTION, not by looking the company up later. If a member's VAT status changes next year, last year's invoices must still show what applied AT THE TIME. This is the same rule as capturing settings values at run time for replay.
3. CAPTURE COUNTRY AT THE POINT OF SALE. Not reconstructible afterwards from Stripe.

== GETPAID ALREADY DOES THIS AND WE NEED OUR OWN ==

FABLE — BEB-5986 FILED, P2. TIME CHECKOUT. Alex 2026-08-26: the time bank was handwaving — go build it, so WP communities can use it, plus the API as a CHECKOUT METHOD. He was right that it was handwaving; 5972 described a model, this builds it.

FIVE CALLS, API-FIRST then MCP then UI: bank_hour · confirm_hour · transfer · balance · period_report. The RECIPIENT confirms; an unconfirmed hour reads UNPROVEN and is never counted, never spendable, never in a funder report. Same rule as a feed row with no proof.

WP COMMUNITIES GET IT THROUGH THE EXISTING CONNECT PLUGIN (BEB-2265) — not a second plugin, not a fork. A buurtvereniging, church, sports club or wijkraad logs and confirms hours on the site they already have.

HOURS AS A CHECKOUT METHOD, and this is the part that makes it live: register as a payment gateway, GetPaid first since GD sites are the estate, Woo next. Buyer picks HOURS at checkout; reserve, debit on completion, release on failure — the same two-phase as money, one mechanism, different unit. Communities price membership, an event place, a room, a moestuin plot, a directory listing.

THE LINE THAT MUST NOT BE CROSSED — making hours spendable is exactly where this can slide into regulated territory, so four hard rules and they are capability checks, not documentation:
1. A merchant sets a PRICE IN HOURS, never an exchange rate. "2 hours OR EUR 20" is TWO PRICES. The system must be INCAPABLE of expressing hours-per-euro anywhere — prove it by inspection.
2. NO REDEMPTION. A merchant is never settled in euros for an hours purchase. The moment they can convert, this is e-money and needs a licence.
3. NON-COMMERCIAL CIRCLE ONLY. A community pricing its own membership in hours is mutual aid; a COMMERCIAL business taking hours for a commercial good is BARTER — in het economisch verkeer, taxable for both sides. A commercial org attempting to enable the gateway is REFUSED BY NAME.
4. No euro refunds on an hours purchase. Hours back or nothing.

FABLE — BEB-5986 RAISED TO P1 AND RETITLED: GD LETS. Alex 2026-08-26: "just make the LETS system for GD and stop talking about it. With full IDaaS, Cue confirm on delivery."

He is telling us to stop specifying. Three corrections that make it concrete, all on the ticket:

1. IT IS A GD FEATURE, not a generic time bank with a GD adapter bolted on later. Every Bebond customer runs GeoDirectory — so listings, categories, locations, the connect plugin and GetPaid are the substrate from the first line.

2. FULL IDaaS. No local accounts, no per-vereniging user table, no shadow identity. A member is an IDaaS subject, the SAME subject they are everywhere else. That is what makes cross-org transfer possible at all — you cannot send hours to a person who exists as two records.

3. CONFIRM-ON-DELIVERY THROUGH CUE, and this is the mechanic that decides whether the whole thing is trustworthy. The helper logs the hour; the RECIPIENT confirms it IN CUE — which is the waterfall filtered to events addressed to this person, already ruled in BEB-2394, needing no new surface. Until confirmed the hour is UNPROVEN: not counted, not spendable, not in a balance, not in a funder report. Every LETS scheme that failed, failed here.

Everything else stands: five API calls first then MCP then UI, GD surface through the existing connect plugin, hours as a GetPaid gateway using the same reserve/settle two-phase as money. Four hard rules as CAPABILITY CHECKS not documentation — price in hours never a rate, no redemption, non-commercial circle only with a commercial org refused BY NAME, no euro refunds.

Still behind the spine, and it does not jump it: BEB-3553 → wallet key + handle names → 4627 → 5903. But it is P1 now and it is a build ticket, not a spec.

FABLE — GD APPOINTMENTS IS THE SUBSTRATE, AND SETTLEMENT IS INTERRUPTED. Alex 2026-08-26, on BEB-5986. Goal set, weight 7, 2026-09-30.

1. DO NOT INVENT A BOOKING MECHANISM. GD already has geodir_appointments — in the premium addons folder, installed three times over. It already models SERVICE, PROVIDER, AVAILABILITY, BOOKING and STATUS. That is the entire front half of a LETS exchange, battle-tested. LETS RIDES IT. A neighbour offering boodschappen doen is a SERVICE on a listing; a request is a BOOKING. We add the hours payment and the ledger; we do not rebuild scheduling. Same rule as GetPaid for VAT and WP Easy Updates for delivery: read the shipped feature, take the shape, add only our part. READ IT FIRST and map the states, the hooks on book/complete/cancel/no-show, and the gateway integration point. Name what we do NOT use.

2. SETTLEMENT IS INTERRUPTED, and this is the correction that matters. An appointment is BOOKED IN ADVANCE and DELIVERED LATER, so hours must NOT settle at booking:
   BOOK → RESERVE. Held, not spent — the requester cannot double-spend the same hours across two bookings.
   DELIVERY → provider marks delivered, RECIPIENT CONFIRMS IN CUE. Only that settles the reserve.
   CANCEL / NO-SHOW → RELEASE, and the release is a LEDGER ROW, never an absence.
   HOLD TTL — an unsettled reserve is a leak and a named red. BEB-1665's hold-TTL sweep is the existing pattern. Never leak a hold.
That is Sentinel's two-phase reserve/settle unchanged — one mechanism, different unit. It is also why the money path had to be right first: we are not building a second settlement engine for hours.

3. WHAT THE INTERRUPTION FORCES US TO DECIDE, named in the build rather than discovered: who confirms a no-show and what happens when the recipient simply does not answer — a TIMEOUT WITH A DEFAULT OUTCOME per the HITL bound, because a parked confirmation with no timeout is a silent stall, the 46-stalls class · whether a late cancel releases or partially settles, as a SET

FABLE — PRICING RULING, AND IT IS A BIG ONE. Alex 2026-08-26, in two steps.

FIRST HE CORRECTED ME. I was applying per-minute compute metering to plugin-shaped features. Wrong — a GD Option is a few D1 rows and KV reads; metering that per minute measures noise and produces a bill nobody can read. His words: we build based on CF fees, and for a plugin there is a credit-per-day cost, arbitrary, to cover SUPPORT.

SO: TWO PRICING CLASSES, and every priced thing declares which it is. Filed on BEB-2878.
- CLASS 1 MEASURED — real vendor cost + 17%, min 1 credit. AI calls, Vectorize, containers, Browser Run, R2 at volume, external APIs. Cost live from Sentinel config. Genuinely bundled serving shows EUR 0 explicitly rather than padded.
- CLASS 2 STANDING — credits per day, chosen by us, covering support. Plugin-shaped things. Arbitrary in the honest sense: chosen, not derived.
HONESTY RULE: say which it is ON THE PRICE. A fake per-minute breakdown over a plugin is the ghost-CRM failure applied to a bill, and it is worse than a flat fee because it invites the customer to check it.

THEN HE EXTENDED IT: ALL PREMIUM PLUGINS SELL THE SAME WAY. Class 2, per day. Filed on BEB-3899.
That is a bigger decision than it looks. The whole WP premium industry sells an ANNUAL PER-SITE LICENCE, tiered, auto-renewing, where the key's real job is update access — EDD SL, Freemius, AppSero, WooCommerce API Manager all implement that and no author enjoys owning it. We sell the same plugins as a daily standing charge on the meter we already built.
Consequences, all ours to state plainly: no renewal date so no lapse cliff and no dunning · no seat maths, per tenant not per site · STOP ANY DAY, which no incumbent can offer · ONE BILL for plugins, GD Options, AI abilities and hosting on the same ledger with markup separable · and patronage returns the markup to members.

FABLE — THREE RULINGS THAT COMPLETE THE STANDING-CHARGE MODEL. Alex 2026-08-26. Filed on BEB-3606.

1. RESERVE NOT MET → DISABLE. Not debt, not grace, not soft overrun. Profit-not-debt applied to a RUNNING feature, not just a new one. But disable has four requirements and none is optional: NAMED never silent, with the exact shortfall · REVERSIBLE ON PAYMENT, back on the next tick, no reinstatement step · DATA SURVIVES, disabled is OFF not DELETED — for LETS a member's banked hours do not vanish because the vereniging's balance ran dry, hours-never-expire is law and a billing lapse must not be a back door around it · and WARNED BEFORE IT HAPPENS. Reserving days ahead is exactly what makes that warning possible; use the window for it.

2. THE RESERVE GROWS — it is a FORECAST, not a flat fee. Sized from IDaaS subject count and the DEPLOY FORECAST. A two-member buurtvereniging and a 200-member one reserve different amounts for the same feature with nobody setting a tier. That is the forecast work (BEB-3501) earning its keep.
BUT A GROWING RESERVE MUST NEVER BE A SURPRISE: the inputs that drove it are VISIBLE — "your reserve rose because you added N members / deployed Z" — because a reserve that grows for invisible reasons is indistinguishable from arbitrary billing. It is BOUNDED by a per-tenant ceiling as a settings row, and hitting the ceiling ASKS rather than silently reserving more. Forecast vs actual is recorded so the forecast improves; unconsumed reserve RELEASES as a ledger row, never an absence.

3. THE 3-DAY WINDOW IS ALEX'S SETTING, not a constant. Settings row, changeable without deploy, bounded, refusing out-of-range by name. Recorded as the current value rather than as the design.

Six acceptance items added to 3606 covering all of it, including that a disable preserves data and that reserve size visibly varies with subjects and forecast.

FABLE — BEB-5998 FILED, P2. NOSTR REPUTATION for the marketplace. Alex 2026-08-26.

THE PRIMITIVE IS ALREADY BUILT — BEB-2297 LANDED: an owner's npub signs {image_hash, GERS_id, listing_id, ts}, the claim lands on the place node, attested entries flag in the WebSub feed. This ticket extends the SUBJECT of a claim from listing media to REPUTATION. Do not re-author the signing.

FOUR MARKETPLACES, ONE MECHANISM: plugin authors (20k of them and no way to tell them apart is a market nobody can shop in) · agencies · LETS providers, the highest-stakes case because someone is entering a neighbour's home · and the coop's own record.

WHY NOSTR AND NOT A STAR RATING IN OUR D1: a review in our database is OUR assertion; a signed event is the REVIEWER'S. We cannot forge it, cannot quietly edit it, and can be caught if we drop it. It is also PORTABLE — a provider or author who leaves takes their standing with them, because it was never ours. No marketplace makes that promise and it is the honest one for a coop.

THE HARD PART, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: a signature proves WHO said it, not that it is TRUE. So the defences:
- ONLY SETTLED EXCHANGES CAN BE RATED. A review must reference a real settled call, a confirmed LETS hour, a paid invoice. No transaction, no review, refused by name. That is BEB-5886's third invariant applied to reputation — NO CLAIM WITHOUT AN EVENT BEHIND IT — and it is the strongest anti-fraud measure available, free to us because we already hold the settlement record.
- MUTUAL REVIEWS RELEASE SIMULTANEOUSLY. Neither side sees the other's until both have written or the window closes; otherwise the first mover holds the second hostage, which is how these systems rot.
- NEGATIVE CLAIMS SURVIVE. A correction is a NEW OPPOSING EVENT, never a rewrite or a deletion. Deleting on request is what makes every rating system worthless.
- LEAD WITH SETTLED-EXCHANGE VOLUME, not a star average. Faking volume means paying for real settled transactions, which is the point.

FABLE — BEB-5999 FILED. Alex 2026-08-26: 5998 is for PROVIDER DIRECTORIES; the ABILIFI MARKETPLACE ratings were not covered. This is that gap.

THE DISTINCTION, and it is why they are two tickets:
- 5998 rates a PERSON OR ORG — did the provider turn up, did the agency deliver. Human judgement, signed, portable.
- 5999 rates a THING — does this ability, frag, plugin or block actually work. And a software component does not need an opinion poll, BECAUSE WE METER EVERY CALL IT MAKES.

THAT IS THE WHOLE INSIGHT: for a marketplace item WE ALREADY HAVE THE TRUTH. Sentinel records every invocation with its outcome, cost and latency. Stars are what you use when you cannot measure. We can measure. So the rating is DERIVED, never typed:
success rate · real cost per call, median and spread · latency median and p95 · adoption · 30-DAY RETENTION — of the orgs that tried it, how many are still calling it — and freshness, so a dead ability reads dead rather than five-starred from a year ago.
RETENTION IS THE STRONGEST SIGNAL AND LEADS: faking it means paying for sustained real usage.

SIGNED HUMAN CLAIMS ARE SECONDARY and reuse 5998's machinery unchanged — for the things the meter cannot see: docs were wrong, output was technically successful and useless, author fixed a bug in a day. Only from an org with SETTLED CALLS against that item. Shown BESIDE the numbers, never blended into them.

NO SINGLE STAR SCORE. A composite hides exactly the trade-off a buyer is making — cheap-and-flaky versus expensive-and-solid is a CHOICE, not a ranking. Show the numbers.

THE ONE THAT MATTERS LONG TERM: the ratings are an API, so AN AGENT PICKING A TOOL AT RUNTIME reads success rate and cost the way a human reads stars. That is the marketplace working at machine speed, and it is why measured-not-opinion is the right call rather than a preference.

GUARDS: every figure resolves to real settled calls or renders NO USAGE YET as a named state — a fabricated number on a purchase decision is the ghost

FABLE — THE GOAL, NOT THE FEATURE. Alex 2026-08-26: "there are frag authors, plugin authors — it's a gap goal I want to close. I want them USING abilifi, see?"

Seen, and it reframes everything filed in the last hour. Goal set, weight 9, 2026-10-31: AUTHORS USING ABILIFI.
